import: Adapted encoding, drain and packet time-base sequence; no whole example binary or replacement media backend
modifications: RAII track encoders; custom local staging I/O; bounded interleaved input; SDR Rec.709; typed configuration and explicit finalization/cancellation
dependencies: Existing isolated vcpkg FFmpeg 6.1.1#11 LGPL SDK; no FFmpeg rebuild or shared SDK upgrade
status: MPEG-4/AAC validated on Windows and USB Android; H264/MF CFR validated in a dedicated encoder thread inside the Windows offline export host. No Android H264 or hardware encoding claim.

additional_study.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later; study only, no copied source
additional_study.decision: camera_record option requests CFR; software MF encoding is not GPU interoperability evidence
additional_study.decoder_tail: FFmpeg n6.1.1 libavcodec/decode.c and libavformat/mov.c: LGPL study only, no source copied. Exact MOV final packet duration trims AAC frame padding in our adapter; no generic duration-based truncation.
additional_study.thread_apartment: FFmpeg mfenc.c rejects the SDL window thread STA apartment. A dedicated encoder thread owns all FFmpeg encoding/MF objects; the render host transfers at most two queued frames plus one active frame.
